column1: # Self-test cases for scripts/smoke.sh and scripts/interop.sh, against the baseline fixture.
#   1  id         stable dotted scenario id of results.json; never change it
#   2  state      "ro" (the case changes nothing another case reads) or "rw". Servers
#                 are shared by the clients of an adapter, in the order of this file;
#                 nothing reads Access.ReadWrite back, and the history sequence starts
#   3  exit       expected exit code of the client; "-" when only the document counts
#   4  expect     jq filter that must hold on the result document (docs/CONTAINER_CONTRACT.md)
#   5  needs      comma-separated, all must hold, or the case is reported as unsupported:
#                   client:<x>   clientOperations or clientFeatures has x
#                   server=<n>   the server adapter is n
#   6  operation  arguments of "client"; the runner adds --endpoint after the first word.
#                 $M is the namespace prefix of the model (nsu=...;s=).
# The document must also be a result envelope (schemaVersion, adapter, success).
